title: Very nice looking but battery case was terrible .
text:
Very nice looking but battery case was terrible .. Very pretty clock But quaity of the battery unit was terrible. I struggled to try and fit a battery in and yes, I has the correct size.
The battery case was loose and kept moving around. What a shame I returned it.
